messages:
maria: FYI customer reported weird billing on embeds: mixed dims in one batch, billed as if all were largest dim

dan: can you paste the raw request?
maria: pasted in ticket: https://redwood.internal/t/12345 — 8 items: 6x512, 2x1536. billed units = 12288 (i.e., 8 * 1536)
sree: that aligns with our current estimator using max(dim) per batch for unit calc. intended for routing simplicity but messy for billing optics
alek: runtime packs to the largest shape for coalesced kernels. avoids padding internal fragmentation but inflates "units" when we expose largest-dim accounting

zoe: is this primarily a billing/console UX issue or do we also want to change routing?
maria: customer is mostly upset about surprise invoice. they want per-item units or at least per-dim breakdown so they can understand cost

sree: small proposal set: (1) preflight estimate API that returns per-dim and conservative estimates, (2) telemetry hooks to track estimate vs actual, (3) optional runtime smart-split that routes same-dim groups separately

dan: preflight sounds low risk. smart-split risks p99 regressions because it multiplies requests. need benching and load tests
alek: agreed. smart-split will increase scheduling overhead but can cut billed units substantially for heterogeneous batches. We should measure throughput impact for worst-case mixes

zoe: console: show a per-request expandable breakdown and a per-route 24h summary of units by dim. small tooltip about why packing happens.
maria: SDK: add an opt-in hedging prefight `embeddings.estimate()` call and a `shape_hint` header to let client pass expected dims to skip expensive inference of shapes
sree: metric suggestions: emit `embed.estimate.request` and `embed.estimate.delta.p95` plus `embed.smart_split.enabled.count` and `embed.shape_grouping.ratio`
dan: security/quotas: mark preflight calls as `estimate` label so they don't consume free tier credits and rate-limit them to prevent abuse
alek: implementation detail: preflight can run packing heuristics without scheduling to be cheap; router returns lower_bound and conservative_bound (what runtime would do under load). returns breakdown array like [{dim:512,count:6,est_units:3072},{dim:1536,count:2,est_units:3072}] and totals

zoe: UX suggestion: SDK shows conservative estimate and a subtle warning, Console shows both numbers and a link to sample requests that triggered smart-split savings
ingest-bot: canary: preflight API rollout (10% of SDK calls) scheduled for 2026-04-12 06:00 UTC. telemetry-only mode for 2 weeks before smart-split toggle flip

sree: ops: add alert `embed.shape_estimate_mismatch > 20%` to platform-dashboard. Also track `embed.smart_split.p99_latency_delta` after flip
dan: timeline: telemetry + console mock by EOD Fri, preflight API canary next Tue, smart-split behind feature flag ~3w after canary if metrics look good
alek: I will add bench PR measuring mixed-dim 50/50 worst-case and post expected RPC increase numbers

maria: action items: Alek bench PR, Zoe console mock, Sree metric+alert, Dan coordinate canary, Maria respond to CS with interim explanation and opt-in preflight link
sree: ack. I'll add the new metrics and a dashboard tile for per-dim billing breakdown
maria: thanks team :+1:
